review.posthog_relevance: Cloudinary warehouse ingestion: the backend could receive a 400 from Cloudinary before the usage day has started; this hunk prevents the ingestion from continuing past that day and avoids losing the restatement window, while still raising the error for other 400s. This could preserve warehouse ingestion correctness and prevent partial or corrupted warehouse records.
